THIS IS THE SECOND APP, and the root package.json used to say what that would
trigger: '@ab-ovo/web-kit ... is created when the SECOND app arrives.' It has been
created — see web/web-kit/package.json — and the loader crossing this package made
(src/content.ts, gone with the bundle in #171) was redirected to it in the same commit,
exactly the 'one import to redirect rather than a search' its own header predicted. See
docs/architecture/MCP-SERVER-SKETCH.md §6, updated alongside this file rather than left
describing a trigger that already fired.
Two runtime dependencies: the MCP SDK, and @ab-ovo/web-kit for the reading order
(isOpenWhere), the grouping and adjacency of a track's programs, and the content API's
wire shapes. Since #171 this server is a client of AbOvo.Api (ADR-0066 §1): the book, the
reveal gate and the reader's place are the API's, reached by src/api.ts over the global
fetch, and nothing here loads a bundle — no book, no fetch script and no compiler are
needed to run it, only AB_OVO_API_URL. The unit tier runs against a stub of the API
(src/testing/stub-api.ts), which serves it the committed fixture.

version BEFORE importing the TypeScript server, because the Node that cannot strip
types cannot parse src/server.ts to be told so. `pnpm start` goes through it too, so
the one path a developer tries is the one a host uses.
